blocks.text:
The itinerary is based in one city, so you spend little time in transit and get to see several sides of Rio.

Visit Christ the Redeemer on Corcovado and Sugarloaf Mountain, take a boat trip to the tropical islands of Angra dos Reis and Ilha Grande, and spend an evening at one of Rio's LGBTQIA+ bars. There's also a free day. Excursions are led by an English- or Spanish-speaking guide.

In the morning, you can ride through the Tijuca Forest to Christ the Redeemer. In the afternoon, stroll along the seafront, then head to Ipanema for music and nightlife. Rio is known for its lively nights, progressive arts scene and major Pride events. Its bars, clubs, cafés and beaches bring together people from all walks of life, and that openness is part of the city today. A beach party, a drag brunch with a caipirinha or a quiet sunset for two can all fit into the same trip.
